info.title: Vendor Service - Section 17C Vendor Own Delivery policy
info.description:
The vendor-configured delivery policy one branch offers on its own riders/fleet, as an alternative to platform Dispatch/Hauling execution.

It configures reach, charge and the minimum/free rules only. It never configures who is paid: vendor-owned delivery pays the vendor and platform delivery pays the executing provider, derived from the execution authority.

This document is separate from the customer planning contract because the two surfaces have different server bases and different principals. One document cannot honestly declare both.

servers.description: Vendor staff surface. Scope is resolved server-side from the session on every request.

get.summary: Read a branch Vendor Own Delivery policy
get.description: Requires vendor.delivery.policy.read at a scope covering the branch. The tenant comes from the authenticated session; a caller-supplied business id is not read at all.

200.description: The policy. ETag carries its version.

404.description: No policy for this branch, or the branch is out of scope. Deliberately the same answer, so a probe cannot tell them apart.

put.summary: Configure a branch Vendor Own Delivery policy
put.description:
Requires vendor.delivery.policy.manage at a scope covering the branch, and If-Match carrying the current version (0 for a first create).

max_delivery_radius_meters may only NARROW the Section 6 branch service area; the planner takes the minimum of the two, so a vendor can never widen its reach from here. The policy configures no beneficiary: vendor-owned delivery pays the vendor and platform delivery pays the executing provider, derived from the execution authority.

403.description: The actor does not hold the permission for this branch.

404.description: The branch does not belong to this tenant.

vendorStaffBearer.description: Vendor staff access token. Scope is resolved server-side from the session on every request.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The policy version this write is made against. 0 means 'I expect no policy yet'.

PolicyInput.description: No business_id: the tenant comes from the authenticated session. No beneficiary: that is derived from the execution authority.

minimum_order_minor.description: A serviceability rule, not a surcharge: below it this vendor does not deliver at all.

free_delivery_threshold_minor.description: Null means this vendor never gives free delivery, which differs from a threshold of zero. Free delivery is a vendor-funded promotion; the delivery still costs what it costs.

max_delivery_radius_meters.description: Narrowing-only override of the branch service area.
